eps.ov: Ghislaine takes Eris to train under the Sword God, but Eris's brash attitude angers the other disciples.
Nina continues to eye Eris as a rival, but training with masters of other styles sparks new discoveries.
Rudeus starts a new life with Roxy and Sylphiette, but not all his friends approve of his second marriage.
Fearful of losing more loved ones, Rudeus begs Roxy to teach him a more potent form of magic.
Rudeus attends Cliff and Elinalise's wedding and goes shopping for his sisters' birthday presents.
Rudeus accompanies Roxy on a bodyguard mission and runs into an unexpected face from his past.
Following a successful summoning experiment, Nanahoshi offers Rudeus a reward.
Rudeus seeks an audience with the hero Perugius, hoping to find a cure for his mother's condition.
Nanahoshi contracts an ancient disease. Seeing her lose hope, Rudeus races to find help.

eps.t: An Audience with an Immortal Demon King
eps.ov: Rudeus and friends locate Kishirika, only to be captured along with her by the guards of a warlike Demon King.
Rudeus receives a puzzling message in his dreams. But before he can act on it, a strange visitor appears.
Rudeus's strange guest recounts his future and reveals the cause of all his misfortunes.
In a future that could have been, Rudeus crumbles under the weight of loss.
Having read one possible future, Rudeus takes action to avoid it and protect the people he loves.
